given: subject A maps only to synthetic UID A; subject B maps only to synthetic UID B
when: A supplies B-like headers, resource IDs, socket hints, and cursors
then: gateway ignores browser routing hints
every A request reaches only A's configured socket
B snapshot and SSE bytes are absent
unknown or duplicate mapping returns identity_mapping_denied

given: daemon socket belongs to user A
when: a peer other than the configured gateway UID connects
then: daemon returns peer_not_authorized without reading native state
a mapping/socket mismatch never falls back to another daemon

given: both named root-created daemon and agent sockets are activated; the agent socket belongs to user A with mode 0600
when: A, B, root and the gateway connect, including queued requests before daemon startup
A supplies identity headers or gateway-only paths
a Pi child supplies absent, forged, old or current inherited launch context
then: only the daemon own UID reaches the agent route table; no native read for other peers
gateway-only handoff, terminal, editor, provisioning and account administration routes are absent
the first queued request is served without being read by the startup probe; overload is bounded
current requires matching live conversation, workspace and launch generation; reads never start Pi
quota read failure is unavailable, not zero or unlimited; filesystem space is separate

given: snapshot watermark is sequence 41
when: native changes occur during snapshot serialization and the client opens events after cursor 41
then: snapshot is an atomic view at 41
the stream starts at 42
no change is lost or applied twice
the daemon-owned live_tail and event_cursor are captured under one journal lock; native changes outside the controller invalidate or require a history read

covers: assistant.delta and tool progress followed by persistent history
Pi agent_settled native key and host timestamp
given: client last applied sequence 42
when: event 42 is replayed then 43 arrives
then: 42 is ignored by event_id/cursor
43 applies once
an out-of-order sequence greater than one marks writes disabled and starts resnapshot
queue.changed carries the agent resource, a revision, and steering/follow_up; it is not a command receipt
history.entry is published only from a readable Pi JSONL entry, carries its persistent native_key, and repeating the native observation does not publish the same key twice
bounded coalesced assistant.delta and tool progress use daemon event IDs; the persisted assistant entry supersedes the turn tail rather than appending a duplicate
turn.settled is observed only after Pi agent_settled, correlated to an assistant native JSONL key or marked unknown if unavailable, with a host observation timestamp
extension_ui_request delivers bounded plain-text question ID, kind and choices even for unknown methods; no raw HTML is forwarded
non-dialog Pi extension UI notifications remain bounded unknown.native plain text without overwriting pending_question; only response-bearing requests become question.requested

given: requested cursor is older than oldest_replay_cursor or names another server instance
when: events endpoint is opened
then: HTTP 409 cursor_expired or cursor_instance_mismatch is returned before SSE starts
client disables writes and atomically replaces state with a fresh snapshot

given: one SSE client cannot keep up with native output
when: the implementation's measured resource or delivery limit is reached
then: that connection closes without stopping Pi or silently losing the current state
reconnect uses replay where available or a fresh snapshot
large native blocks remain readable through bounded per-block pagination under the current wire limits

given: an accepted command remains in the same ledger epoch
when: the identical body and client_command_id are submitted again
then: the original result is returned and execution is not repeated
the same ID with another body returns command_id_conflict

covers: send RPC receipt lookup and replay
given: the connection ends before acceptance response
when: client fetches a fresh snapshot and command status
then: a matching retained result reconciles it
absence never proves non-delivery after ledger epoch change or eviction
there is no automatic resend
a deliberate resend uses a new ID and explicit confirmation
a pending send has a per-command lookup and command.changed acceptance event; accepted is only a correlated Pi RPC acknowledgement; after loss, uncertainty is not retried

given: a daemon-owned RPC turn is running
when: tab and SSE close
then: Pi child continues
later cursor replay or snapshot shows native progress
browser connection is never process owner

given: a daemon-owned RPC turn is running
when: daemon crashes and systemd performs service-level child cleanup
then: native completed history remains
new epoch makes unresolved commands uncertain
an ended browser conversation can be deliberately continued once its previous work is known to have ended; unresolved work cannot gain another writer

given: history is readable and a terminal TUI is observed live
when: browser opens the terminal history or attempts to control it
then: history remains readable without starting a writer
terminal control and takeover are unavailable
daemon does not signal a terminal process

given: owned Pi 1.5.2 RPC advertises verified capabilities
when: message, steer, follow_up, clear_queue or interrupt is sent
then: adapter maps only verified Pi operations
clear_queue clears the whole queue
interruption is best effort and does not claim detached native tools stopped
unsupported or unknown capability returns capability_unsupported or capability_unknown

given: history contains raw HTML, javascript URLs, malformed Markdown/diff, unknown event and control characters
when: snapshot, query, and SSE are decoded
then: schema-invalid envelopes are rejected
valid unknown native payload is escaped generic text
no supplied HTML or URL executes
malformed renderer input retains a plain-text fallback

given: title adapter capability is verified supported and an earlier successful title exists
when: daemon-owned one-off Pi model call fails then a user requests regeneration with a new command ID
then: failure preserves prior title and conversation progress
pending/succeeded/failed are observable
success atomically replaces only title annotation
browser never performs the model call

given: one-off Pi model-call adapter has not been verified
when: snapshot is read or title command is attempted
then: capability is unknown with adapter_not_verified
command fails capability_unknown
display remains Uusi keskustelu or daemon-derived first-message fallback

given: target is a symlink, is replaced after preflight, contains descendant symlinks, or escapes the opened src descriptor
when: create, clone, settings, or delete is requested
then: descriptor-relative no-follow resolution rejects it
outside sentinel is unchanged
error names path_unsupported, path_replaced, or path_escape without disclosing another user's path

given: managed process stop succeeds and manual linked worktree blocks deletion
when: deletion proceeds
then: confirmed stop remains confirmed
workspace removal is skipped
fresh source observation reports directory present
retry requires a new observation token and never claims rollback

given: remote repository creation succeeds but origin setup or plain git push fails
when: operation settles
then: remote creation remains a confirmed effect
failure stage and local Git state remain visible
retry starts only after fresh Git/GitHub/transport observation
no credential is returned to browser

given: one worktree is Taskfleet-owned and another is manual or ownership is unknown
when: teardown or deletion is requested
then: owned teardown uses Taskfleet's exact run identity
manual/unknown worktree is read-only and blocks destructive cleanup
branch display fragment is never treated as ownership

given: user state annotation is missing, invalid, truncated, or has unknown version
when: snapshot is built
then: Pi history, Git, filesystem and Taskfleet facts remain available
only hidden/archive/title/annotated-parent presentation is lost or unknown
source warning is emitted and corrupt bytes are not silently overwritten

given: controlled process is settled and pi history is readable
when: archive then unarchive/resume commands complete
then: archive changes only annotation
resume uses the same pi session ID
no transcript copy or new platform conversation is created

given: the target native resource has changed since the browser observation
when: the browser submits a command with the stale target observation token
then: host returns stale_precondition with fresh_snapshot_required
no mutation starts from the stale target observation
unrelated streamed output alone does not invalidate a command

given: an authenticated cookie exists
when: a write has missing/wrong Origin or missing/wrong session-bound CSRF header
then: gateway returns origin_denied or csrf_denied before daemon routing
no command ledger entry or native effect exists

given: delete preflight returns workspace name and observation token
when: confirmation differs by any code point or token no longer matches filesystem identity
then: confirmation_mismatch or stale_precondition is retained as a rejected command
no process, worktree, or directory mutation starts

given: a session has an open SSE connection
when: logout, idle expiry, absolute expiry, or gateway session restart invalidates it
then: gateway closes that session's SSE connections
reconnect returns authentication_required or session_expired
daemon-owned Pi work continues

given: request declares an unsupported schema version or extra forbidden field
when: gateway/daemon validates it
then: schema_version_unsupported or invalid_request is returned
nothing is entered in the ledger or executed

given: URL after is 41 but client last applied SSE id is cursor 57
when: EventSource reconnects with Last-Event-ID 57
then: server prefers 57 and begins at 58
sequences at or below client last-applied are duplicate replays
only a sequence above last+1 causes a gap

given: an authenticated user's src listing is empty and snapshot supplies user_observation_token
when: workspace.create or workspace.github.clone uses target.scope user and that token
then: daemon binds the token to web identity and opened src descriptor
a changed/missing/replaced src root yields stale_precondition
the first workspace can be created without inventing an existing resource ID

given: a terminal operation result is available in the current daemon epoch
when: the browser reloads or deep-links to its operation ID
then: query returns the staged terminal result with ledger epoch and expiry
eviction or daemon restart returns operation_outcome_unknown
absence never means success

given: steering and follow-up items race with delivery while clear is accepted
when: agent.queue.clear succeeds
then: result contains only actually removed texts with source groups and original indexes
post-clear queue revision is returned
stale failed or uncertain results contain no removed queue

given: a fresh GitHub create capability carries an exact_repository owner/repository challenge
when: confirmation differs by any byte or its observation token is stale
then: confirmation_mismatch or stale_precondition is returned
no GitHub or Git mutation starts

given: a freshly reauthenticated mapped user has connected native GitHub state
when: identity.github.disconnect targets user scope with a fresh user observation token
then: the daemon removes local GitHub CLI authentication without claiming server-side revocation
success is reported only after local auth absence is observed
partial cleanup remains partial and web logout alone preserves native GitHub state

given: browser session is broker-mapped to synthetic UID A and Pi OAuth is absent or unavailable
when: browser checks onboarding once on initial load and direct snapshot/history/block URLs are requested after native status changes
the browser starts native Claude subscription login, opens its authorization URL and submits the returned code once
then: daemon verifies peer and mapped identity on every native read without querying Pi
browser shows first-use onboarding when native Pi status is missing
status returns only missing, usable or unknown and no credential bytes
a different identity or an unavailable daemon never exposes native names
Claude Code alone writes its native store; no credential enters Pi auth or the browser response
an expiring session-bound lease and attempt generation reject foreign or stale code submission; cancellation and lost replies never cause replay
claude-bridge candidates retain provider-qualified identities and newest-per-family grouping

given: a mapped UID has native GitHub access and a home under a Linux user quota
when: the browser starts a clone job, loses or closes its progress stream during a large native Git receive, resubscribes, cancels, or the daemon restarts mid-clone
then: only stage and bounded measurements are emitted, not Git stderr or paths
losing the stream does not cancel the job; a new subscription starts from the job's current state
cancel and native failure remove only the directory this job created, so a new start is admitted
after a daemon restart the leftover is reported as interrupted with its size, hidden from the workspace list, and only removed or restarted by an explicit action
another mapped UID cannot observe the first UID's jobs or progress

given: a mapped UID whose daemon runs the operator's pinned integration tools as that UID
when: the browser lists integrations, connects an app-password account, relays a device code or pasted redirect, chooses folders, signs in again or removes an account
then: every account and status is read from the tool's own files and status command; the host stores no record of connections
a password or token is written only into the tool's own store in the person's home and never returned, logged or echoed
native error text never crosses the contract; failures are fixed codes
a pasted address is accepted only as a loopback redirect and handed only to the tool process this attempt started
an attempt belongs to the browser session that started it; another session can read only that none is its own

each provider has at most one attempt, and only one provider whose sign-in may copy files has a live one; a sign-in that copies no files starts and finishes while another provider's first sync runs, and a read naming a provider shows only that provider's attempt
removal keeps synced directories unless the person asks, and then moves them to the Trash

a choice whose known or estimated size does not fit the home's free room is not made in advance; a drive is also offered folder by folder, or its files left out while the login serves the provider's other services
another mapped UID cannot observe or control the first UID's accounts, attempts or skill

given: a mapped UID whose daemon runs the person's shells as tmux sessions on the product's own tmux server, as that UID, in the workspace's directory
when: the browser lists a workspace's shells, opens a new one or reattaches to one over a WebSocket, watches a Taskfleet window, closes a shell, loses its connection, or its session ends
then: the upgrade is refused unless its Origin is exactly the app's, and the gateway dials the daemon only after the first message proves the session's CSRF token
a browser session holds a bounded number of terminals; logout, revocation and idle or absolute expiry close every relayed terminal of that session
closing the browser or losing the connection leaves the shell running in tmux; the next connection reattaches to the same session
the list says whether shells survive a daemon restart: only when the tmux server runs as the person's user service, otherwise it ends with the daemon
a Taskfleet window is attached read-only: no input reaches it, it is not resized, and Taskfleet's own clients keep their window
listing starts no tmux server; nothing about shells is stored by the host
no message carries a path, socket name or Unix username; native error text never crosses the contract
another mapped UID cannot list, attach to or close the first UID's shells

given: a mapped UID's conversation or new conversation in a workspace, with or without a running Pi
when: the browser lists Pi's commands for `/`, lists, browses by folder or previews the workspace's files for `@` and the picker, runs a typed `!` or `!!` command, or stops it
then: an absent start page is null; an existing invalid or unreadable page reports needs_update without native content or diagnostics, while the daemon logs a fixed reason
the command list is Pi's own get_commands: from the running Pi, otherwise from a short-lived list-only Pi in the workspace that starts no conversation and writes no session; no source path crosses

the file list is the workspace's Git view (tracked and unignored untracked files) or a bounded walk of a plain directory, and its folders with their change counts are derived from the same names; nothing is reached through a symlink, a preview names only a regular file beneath the workspace, and an unavailable list is an error, never an empty one
a `!` command is relayed to the conversation's Pi as RPC bash, runs as the person in the conversation's directory and is recorded only in Pi's own history; `!!` keeps the output from the model
one command runs at a time; a spent command ID is refused; a command typed while Pi is not running waits for the Pi that starts and is never run later if that start fails or the command is taken back
other controls are answered while a command runs; a Pi that ends first leaves the command's outcome uncertain and nothing is repeated
the gateway only relays these routes for the session's own daemon

given: a daemon-owned native Pi conversation with readable history and an open browser for its Unix user
when: the same UID creates an explicit or launch-context notice; another UID, unknown target, stale generation or forged identity hints try the route; native persistence fails with EDQUOT
then: only the daemon own UID reaches notice create/list, on agent.sock only; gateway-only authority is not granted
Pi is the sole writer; native origin and timestamp survive reopening on the current branch, not another conversation or abandoned branch
dry run writes nothing; an idempotency key with changed content is refused
the browser renders notice text without interpreting HTML, script or links, labels agent origin and time, and scopes it to its conversation and current identity
only a successful native disk read establishes persisted; a failed write can deliver an explicitly temporary warning through the existing event journal, never a false persistence or delivery receipt

given: two mapped users and existing UTF-8 files; browser engine is CodeMirror by default
when: a file request supplies traversal, symlink/mount/foreign ownership, stale versions or unsupported metadata
two saves name one inode through workspace/place aliases; deletion overlaps a live file operation
a save fails before staging, during fsync, or after rename; the browser changes identity while reading
then: only the session-mapped daemon resolves held workspace descriptors; denied content is never read or replaced
saves serialize daemon-wide, deletion and file operations exclude overlapping roots, stale bases get file_changed
no failed durability is acknowledged; 5xx/lost replies retain the dirty buffer without retry; identity changes dispose live buffers and stale responses
compact layout uses CodeMirror without overwriting identity-local desktop preference; no browser engine starts code-server

given: root's installed storage policy declares no per-user limits; homes share one filesystem, possibly the root filesystem
when: a person signs in for the first time, reads their storage, starts a clone or an integration sync, or an agent reads its environment
an administrator lists storage or tries to change a person's limit
then: the broker creates the account without a limit and accepts the login without a default limit
storage reads report limits not_in_use with the shared filesystem's capacity and free space, never an unavailable or zero quota
a limit change is refused as storage_limits_not_in_use and nothing is written
clone admission requires free filesystem space instead of a quota; ENOSPC stays storage_full
an unreadable storage policy is treated as the user-quota installation, never as permission to skip limits

given: a browser conversation's Pi stopped (idle, to make room, by the person, by a crash, or with the daemon's restart) and the agent has not been told what happened since
when: the person opens the conversation
the person types the first character
the person sends the message
then: opening shows Habitat's report (when and why Pi stopped, cut-off processes, this conversation's runs that settled unreported with Taskfleet's summaries, runs still working) and starts nothing
typing wakes Pi once without a turn; a repeated or racing wake answers with the running or starting Pi, never a second child or a conflict
the first message carries the same report to the agent, which then appears in history as the rest's marker; the snapshot's rest ends
an unreadable Taskfleet inventory is reported unavailable, never as nothing settled

when Pi stopped (other than by the person) under a background process that would have woken the agent, Habitat wakes the conversation itself once that wait has ended: a cut-off `taskfleet run wait` once its own runs settle as the wait would have returned, any other waking process at once; the agent gets the same report as its turn, and history marks the rest with woke settled or cut_off

given: a person has a Soniox key in their home, saved by them or copied from the site's key, or none
when: the person starts a dictation in the composer
an administrator sets the site's Soniox key
then: the person's own daemon mints one single-use temporary key (60 s to open, 600 s session ceiling, transcribe_websocket only) and returns it with the region's WebSocket URL; the long-lived key never crosses

a missing key, a key Soniox refuses, a reached limit and an unreachable Soniox reach the browser as speech_key_missing, speech_key_rejected, speech_limit_reached and speech_unavailable, never Soniox's own text

a key, the person's or the site's, is saved only once Soniox has taken it, with the region it took it in; a key refused in every region or one Soniox could not be asked about is not saved, and a key stored under the wrong region is tried once in the other and corrected
a site key is written into a home only where there is no key or an earlier site copy; a key the person saved is kept, and the administrator sees counts of answers, never who holds their own key

given: a person's home holds tool caches, worktrees of running and finished Taskfleet runs, a Trash, workspaces and agent history
when: the person opens Storage with the breakdown experiment on
the person asks to measure again
a measurement takes longer than its bound
then: the daemon measures only its fixed list of places in that person's home, as that person, without following symbolic links or crossing mounts
the reply never waits for a measurement: it carries the previous result with measuring true, or no items before the first
a build directory of a worktree a live run holds, or whose run state cannot be read, is live and never offered for clean-up
a measurement over its bound reports what it found with complete false
nothing in the breakdown removes anything; the browser prepares a request for an agent, which the person sends
